newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Unocal Philippine unit workers strike.
newsitem.headline: Unocal Philippine unit workers strike.

text.p: Workers of the Philippine Geothermal Inc (PGI), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Unocal Corp, went on strike on Friday after the company undertook a restructuring programme, PGI said in a statement.
But both its power generating plants were still operating on normal load as all workers had not joined the strike, PGI spokesman Justito Fernandez said.
The 426-megawatt Makban power plant and the 330-megawatt Tiwi power plant supply 17 percent of the total power requirement of the main Luzon island. The two plants employ 400 workers.

"This move surprises us. All along, we have been meeting with the union leaders and the DOLE (Department of Labour Employment) in good faith. Nevertheless, we are keeping our lines of communications open to try to resolve this situation," Fernandez said.
The workers are opposed to the company's downsizing programme. Fernandez did not give details of how many people were affected by the programme.
